description: Run a YAML flow (saved, or inline flowYaml to batch known steps) on the prepared app; mode:"plan" previews per-backend support without a device. Server-side, fail-fast, with setup/teardown; mutating and OCR steps are consent-gated; a failure returns the step, screenshot, failureCode, and health. Pass flow (name/path) or flowYaml, plus variables. Steps: docs/flows.md#step-reference.

backend.description: plan: only this backend (default all five).

consentId.description: run: consent for mutating / OCR steps.

flow.description: Flow name under .swipium/flows, or a .yaml path.

projectRoot.description: plan: absolute app root for flow names.

repeat.description: run: repeat N times to classify flakes.

variables.description: run: ${VAR} values (over session inputs and SWIPIUM_* env); secret-like names are redacted.

name: qa_flow_run
title: Run a flow (or preview its execution plan)
